stem:
An energy pyramid is shown.

Which statement BEST describes the flow of energy through this pyramid?

options.label: A
options.text: Producers provide energy directly to the organisms in all the trophic levels above them.

options.label: B
options.text: Primary consumers transfer energy to the trophic level above them and the trophic level below them.

options.label: C
options.text: Secondary consumers represent the most organisms, and they have the greatest amount of energy in their trophic level.

options.label: D
options.text: Tertiary consumers do not receive all the energy from the trophic level below them, because some energy is lost to the environment.

visual_elements: Energy pyramid with four levels labeled from bottom to top: Phytoplankton, Zooplankton, Aquatic insects, Frogs
